task: Current image plus available past trend -> next observed mean RGB30–120min later
input: meanRGB, grayCV, spotpct, finepattern, previousRGB slopes and availability/gap, next horizon. No composition, owner, date orXRD in model.
primary_target: future meanRGB in JPEG units, modeled as hourlychange and multiplied byforecast horizon
training: 19films, leavefilmout or leavebatchout; all samefilm samples grouped; equalfilm weights; train-onlyStandardScaler; Ridge alpha10 fixed; RF200trees depth3 leaf4 fixed
correction: Eachfilm FIRST photo paper as its own reference; prediction input uses only past/current paper. Future paper is used ONLY to define measured corrected target. Future paper normalization must be available when evaluating. Not a forecast of future lighting.
image_method: quadrilateral warp256, fullframe primary; raw andmargin18% sensitivity; ellipse included. No physical colorcalibration.
known_bad: Nov12 secondphotos only excluded inprimary; includeall sensitivity. October nominaltime uncertainty andBrRb1alignment remain.
forecast_output: Next1h currentfilms forecast using older batches only; no future observed labels, UNVERIFIED.
long_horizon: 24h images retained ininventory but not scored as1h forecast because horizon outside30–120min
